headline: Six Fronts Swap Bases as Casualties Surge
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the churn has deepened on the southern and central arcs. Weathered Expanse remains the war’s graveyard, its 24‑hour toll now 168,743 Colonial and 185,510 Warden dead with nine ownership changes; both casualty streams are still accelerating while enlistments have begun to cool. Linn Mercy continues to drive the heaviest fighting around Rotdust and Lathair, logging twenty‑two flips, 54,057 Colonial and 67,921 Warden casualties, and a sharp rise in recruitment. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to twenty‑one flips, Colonial losses at 50,421 and Warden at 63,071, with Colonial casualties cooling but Warden losses and sign‑ups accelerating. Stlican Shelf reports four flips, casualties climbing to 54,746 Colonial and 60,792 Warden while loss rates cool and enlistments accelerate. Deadlands adds three flips, its 24‑hour toll reaching 98,056 Colonial and 136,406 Warden dead, both sides’ loss rates now cooling. Fresh turnover appears on Farranac Coast (five flips, mixed 2‑Warden/9‑Colonial control), Fishermans Row (four flips, Fort Ember most active), and Gutter (five flips, The Parras busy). Northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors remain quiet with no ownership changes.
